summary: The Form 6-K is a routine earnings release by MIND C.T.I. Ltd. for the first quarter of 2026, reporting revenues, operating income, net income, and cash flow. It includes a business update noting a customer non-renewal and mentions an existing share buyback plan authorized in November 2025. There is no M&A, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return program (the buyback is pre-existing and not the filing event), spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC activity, or forced management change. The filing is a standard periodic report of financial results.
